name: bd_seq
description: The birth/death sequence number identifying this MQTT session.

name: birth_time
description: Timestamp of the NBIRTH that started this session.

name: death_time
description: Timestamp the session was recorded as dead. Null while the consumer believes the session is still alive.

name: death_reason
description: How the death was detected, e.g. 'NDEATH', 'will', 'gap-detected', 'stale-timeout'.
